title.narrative: Accelerating the transition to a net-zero, nature-positive economy in Chile

description.narrative: Note: Disbursement data provided is cumulative and covers disbursement made by the project Agency.
Strengthen Chilean institutions to accelerate nature positive, net-zero development pathways

Through the new public and private climate change instruments and their measurement, biodiversity integration into the financing strategy, energy demand decarbonization policies, and capacity and awareness-raising activities, the project will deliver several socioeconomic benefits: In economic Growth and Job Creation: · Stimulates investment in green technologies and sustainable practices.· Boosts innovation, productivity, and competitiveness.· Creates jobs in renewable energy, energy efficiency, sustainable agriculture, and ecosystem restoration. In enhanced Ecosystem Services and Resilience: · Helps safeguard critical ecosystem services like clean water, fertile soil, and pollination.· Helps protecting and restoring natural ecosystems, supporting economic activities such as agriculture, tourism, and fisheries. In energy Security and Affordability: · Reduces dependence on fossil fuels.· Lowers energy costs for households and businesses.· Creates jobs in renewable energy infrastructure.· Improved Public Health:· Reduces air pollution and its associated health risks.· Lowers healthcare costs. Social Inclusion and Empowerment: · Fosters broader social acceptance and support for climate action.· Enhances employability through green skills training.· Improves livelihoods, particularly for women.
